name: Semantic context
responsibility: One per tab session for voice and one per workhorse for the boards of its checkout: turns the panes' gestures and every settled board change into briefs and events
description: Each brief names its board's vault, so a thread passes it to the CLI with -C. The voice side hears the board changes of the vaults its tab session's panes are in, and a workhorse hears only those of the vaults in its own checkout, so it is told about the boards it works on.

outgoing.label: the user's changes, focus and selection
